simple.meaning: מָהִיר (mâhîyr) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “quick ; hence, skilful.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 4 times across Ezra, Psalms, Proverbs, Isaiah, beginning at Ezra 7:6. Its contexts include family line, death, righteousness, Torah, kingship, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מָהִיר (H4106).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: מָהִיר (mâhîyr) / H4106 is traced through Ezra 7:6, Psalms 45:2, Proverbs 22:29, Isaiah 16:5 as a generated source-based concept entry.
